writeup: TIC 295035279 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 12.3287 days. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 20.47% dimming, and a secondary eclipse was detected at 7.2 sigma significance occurring at orbital phase 0.27. Automated analysis of TESS photometry data yielded a strong detection signal with a BLS signal-to-noise ratio of 243.2, and pixel-level difference imaging confirmed the signal with a peak signal-to-noise of 44.0, though the centroid offset of 2.9 arcsec from the target merits consideration. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. The detection passed all data quality checks without flagged concerns, though the machine-learning screening score of 0.46 indicates moderate confidence from the automated classification model.
